description: The Tamil Nadu e-Governance Agency has invited technology partners to build the Vetri Integrated e-Sevai 2.0 platform — an AI-enabled stack meant to scale citizen services from 275 to 1,000, with DigiLocker, Aadhaar, e-Sign and a “no application” delivery model.
body_lead: Tamil Nadu is preparing the next leap for its statewide citizen-service network. The Tamil Nadu e-Governance Agency (TNeGA) has issued an Expression of Interest for the Vetri Tamil Nadu Integrated e-Sevai 2.0 Platform — an artificial intelligence-enabled system designed to bring up to 1,000 government services onto a single stack, against the 275 services available on the current e-Sevai platform.
